about: Where each platform draws its own UI over a video, as fractions of the frame (x0, y0, x1, y1; y down). TikTok and Reels follow a safe-zone guide's 1080×1920 templates (2026-11-17); before them, measured on the user's own phone (2026-10-20). Shorts are Google's numbers, not yet measured. YouTube's 16:9 player publishes none: its zones are the player's own title and controls, with the 90% title-safe frame. The apps move: update this file, not the code.

layouts.title: TikTok
layouts.source: A safe-zone guide's template (1080×1920, 2026-11-17): 160 px top, 120 px each side, the caption band the bottom 480 px, the rail from 780 px across and 840 px down. Before it, measured 2026-10-20 on the user's Android and widened to iPhone guides
